globalRules: Send original cover as primary image reference; this JSON is supplementary guidance, not a replacement for source pixels.
Only change Crew slots assigned to uploaded guest character images. Do not change any fixed book characters.
Keep original camera, framing, aspect ratio, perspective, colours, style, lighting, scenery and story action as close to original as possible.
Match new Crew to each slot’s pose, age-appropriate proportions, outfit, placement and interactions. Preserve guest facial identity from their references.
Do not add or remove background characters, animals, props or text unless explicitly instructed.
Where precise preservation is required, use an editable mask of Crew regions and composite protected elements if needed.
Do not interpret the grandmother-looking sorceress in the superhero cover as the Crew grandmother.
If a Crew slot is unassigned, retain the original character unless the product explicitly requests removal.
